laws.rule: Tara National Park: visitor centre RSD 100 (pupils RSD 50); Crveni potok reserve RSD 100 adults, children with parents free; guide up to 6 hours RSD 5,500; bear-watching tour RSD 6,000 per person. (No RBA rate for RSD; at the National Bank of Serbia rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 73.8203 RSD: RSD 100 ≈ A$1.35; RSD 50 ≈ A$0.68; RSD 5,500 ≈ A$74.51; RSD 6,000 ≈ A$81.28)
